AgNP-containing PUU composites are characterized by the presence of AgNP with a broad size distribution and a strong plasmonic band, a presence of 2D and 3D structures of AgNP, a presence of a large amount of ionic by-product, a shift of thermal decomposition maximum to higher values, a decrease in tensile strength and elongation at the break of composites in comparison with neat PUU, and a specific sorption behavior of composites.

PUU/AgNP composites with different content of nanofiller were successfully synthesized by in situ synthesis method, which is characterized by the presence of broad plasmon absorption band in the UV-vis spectra, and the presence of the nanofiller affects the structure, thermal, and mechanical properties of the PUU matrix.
